author: Nerdstalgic
description:
On paper, the premise of Mrs. Doubtfire sounds absurd… even unsettling. But in the hands of Robin Williams, it became something magical. He transformed what could have been a simple high-concept comedy into a heartfelt story about family, love, and sacrifice.
